# Riemann zeta zeros 1..10 to 2048 decimals.
# Method: escalating-precision Newton on zeta(1/2+it), full-precision seeds;
# certificates: index at inter-zero midpoint (full floor), position = |zeta| at
# the zero, multiplicity = S-jump. Produced in Python/mpmath on an Apple M3.
1 14.
2 21.
3 25.
4 30.
5 32.
6 37.
7 40.
8 43.
9 48.
10 49.
